===No set is an element of itself===
Let <math>A</math> be a set, and apply the axiom of regularity to <math>\{A\}</math>, which is a set by the [[axiom of pairing]]. By this axiom, there must be an element of <math>\{A\}</math> which is disjoint from <math>\{A\}</math>. Since the only element of <math>\{A\}</math> is <math>A</math>, it must be that <math>A</math> is disjoint from <math>\{A\}</math>. So, since <math display="inline">A \cap \{A\} = \varnothing</math>, we cannot have <math>A</math>  an element of <math>A</math> (by the definition of [[Disjoint sets|disjointness]]).
